body.x: Dreamlight participated in “CES(Consumer Electronics Show) 2018 Unveiled” held on January 7, 2018 in Las Vegas, USA to introduce a one-stop sleep therapy service which is user-adjustable.

Dreamlight is an organic sleep assisting device which uses beautiful sounds and lights of nature in order to help you fall into sleep naturally. It can provide you with one-stop sleep therapy service through its modes such as light sleep assistance, sleep music broadcasting, jet lag, etc. Its “Greenlight” function helps you wake from sleep naturally while improving your skin condition through its infrared technologies. It is also light and easy to clean as well as being easy to be charged from all kinds of power supply devices.
Using Dreamlight application, you can track your sleep cycle, and also can check the quality and time of your sleep. Furthermore, you can find out the fit-for-your sleep time evaluated with your DNA.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
